test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many editions of the Indian Premier League (IPL) T20 Cricket tournament have been held till 2020?
solution: The correct answer is **13**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **The Indian Premier League **is a **domestic T20 cricket tournament **in **India**. • It is **organized **by **IPL Governing Council **and comes under the **Board of Control for Cricket in India**. • It is the **most watched Twenty20 tournament **and the **second-best paying porting league globally**. • IPL was **established in 2008**. • It consists of **10 teams **from **10 cities across India**. • **13 editions **of the IPL tournament have been **held till 2020**.
